messages.subject: [Rpy] rpy2-2.4.3 is released
messages.body_plain:
It is on Pypi and the changes are:


Release 2.4.3
=============

Bugs fixed
----------

- `geom_raster` was missing from `rpy2.robjects.lib.ggplot2` (pull 
request #30)

- Fixed issue with SVG rendering in ipython notebook (issue #217)

- Regression with `rx2()` introduced with new conversion (issue #219)

- Fixed documentation (missing `import`) (issue #213)




------------------------------------------------------------------------------
